---
name: Experiment
about: A hypothesis with a metric and a pass condition decided in advance
labels: experiment
---

## Hypothesis
(One testable sentence. Example: "PASR-Lite is preferred over a generic virtualiser.")

## Metric
(What is measured, and how.)

## Gate (pass condition, written before running)

## Method
(Data, settings, number of listeners or clips, level matching.)

## If it fails
(The fallback that still works.)

## Result
(Filled in afterwards: numbers, intervals, notes. Report failures too.)
